mask_definition: Retained patches keep their original confidence; rejected patches receive confidence zero. Top fractions retain exactly ceil(N*f) patches independently per image.

transforms.per_image_zscore: Production transform: independently center and unit-standardize every image before tanh.
transforms.shared_base: Recommended diagnostic: use one mean/std measured from the RU base for every image and every counterfactual.
transforms.center_only: Center each image but do not divide by its spatial standard deviation.

compositions.production_roundtrip: Reproduce production full/shuffled: resize base 10->14, add delta, then resize the complete map 14->10.
compositions.ru_additive: RU-preserving counterfactual: resize only delta 14->10 and add it to the untouched base10; a zero mask is exactly the RU base.

limitations: This is a fixed-feature teacher-target counterfactual, not a retrieval evaluation.
It cannot determine which target improves R@1 without matched retraining.
One fixed batch is descriptive; repeat across batches/cities before retraining.
